::: cv-section
### Profile

I'm passionate about Quantitative Development of Financial Models and the modern interplay between AI, Finance, and Accounting. I have worked in the area of Mathematical and Statistical Modeling for more than 20 years, now fully focused on the adoption of Data Science and Machine Learning solutions in the financial and academic sector.
:::

------------------------------------------------------------------------

::::::: cv-section
### Experience

::: cv-entry
[**Senior Quant Risk Analyst**]{.cv-role} · [CaixaBank, Barcelona]{.cv-org} · [12/2016 – Currently]{.cv-period}

Validation of Stochastic Fair Value Models and Payoff Functions for the CaixaBank Financial Markets Risk Desk. Designing Probabilistic Simulation-Based Models compliant with several regulation requirements. Passionate about clean code, version control, and efficient numerical programming to avoid computational burdens in high-intensive calculations.
:::

::: cv-entry
[**Quant Analyst**]{.cv-role} · [Consultora Riesgos Financieros, Madrid]{.cv-org} · [07/2015 – 11/2016]{.cv-period}

Development of a micro-based Credit Model to estimate Private Ratings for Securitization Funds. Expert Third-Party Valuations and Risk Measurements for Financial Institutions.
:::

::: cv-entry
[**Postdoctoral Scholar**]{.cv-role} · [Univ. CEU Cardenal Herrera, Elche]{.cv-org} · [06/2013 – 06/2015]{.cv-period}

Research Associate under the Prometheus II Grant of Excellence. Development of Screening Rules inferred by Heuristic Ranking of Financial Stocks. Lecturing Financial Econometrics and Portfolio Valuation.
:::

::: cv-entry
[**Research PhD Assistant Professor**]{.cv-role} · [Univ. Alicante, Alicante]{.cv-org} · [09/2012 – 06/2013]{.cv-period}

Development of Numerical Methods for Parabolic PDEs related with Free Frontier Problems in Quantitative Finance (Option Pricing). Lecturing Introduction to Financial Mathematics.
:::
:::::::
